 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Norway return to Ullevaal Stadion on Saturday knowing they have little room for error in their  Nations League campaign . Ståle Solbakken's side have lost their last three Group A4 matches after opening the competition with a win over Denmark, leaving them bottom of the group with three points from four games.
 Wales arrive in Oslo on the same number of points, but they have already beaten Norway 2-1 in Cardiff. With two matches left to play, both teams need a result to keep their hopes of reaching the quarter-finals alive and avoid the threat of relegation.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement For Norway, this is a chance to turn things around in front of their home fans. Erling Haaland will once again be central to their plans, with the Manchester City striker expected to lead the attack. But will he be in the starting lineup tonight?
 Is Erling Haaland playing tonight?
 Erling Halaand will start for Norway against Wales. 
 According to the latest team news, he is in line to earn his 60th international cap. He has already scored 65 goals for Norway and will be looking to add to that tally against Wales.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Norway vs. Wales Confirmed Lineups
 Norway Starting XI: 
 Selvik
 Ryerson, Ajer, Hoggem, Wolfe
 Aasgaard, Berge
 Bobb, Odegaard, Nusa
 Halaand
 Wales manager Craig Bellamy has a few selection issues to deal with. Ben Cabango and Sorba Thomas are suspended, while Harry Wilson is available again after missing the previous international window through injury.
 Wales Starting XI/ 
 Darlow
 Williams, Davies, Dasilva, Rodon
 Ampadu, Wilson
 Johnson, Cullen, James
 Koumas
